skill.name: tradehand
skill.description: Find local UK tradespeople, inspect services and reviews, and use Tradehand's signed-in customer tools to prepare fixed-price bookings, request quotes and hand off Stripe payment links. Use when the user chooses Tradehand to find or book help for a local job.
skill.summary: Find UK tradespeople through Tradehand, review live booking details, request quotes, and check job and payment status.
skill.author: humanleap

content.user_title: Find and Book UK Tradespeople with Tradehand
content.value_statement: Finding local tradespeople requires checking real listings, service options, and current availability. Tradehand guides connected assistants through searches, quotes, approved bookings, and payment handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Guides searches for public UK trade listings by job and location using Tradehand tools.
Guides inspection of trader listings and service options while preserving returned identifiers.
Prepares fixed-price bookings and presents live totals, addresses, and time slots before customer approval.
Uses advertised quote tools to request pricing when no fixed-price service applies.
Hands off checkout links for approved bookings or amounts due on existing jobs.
Checks signed-in customer jobs and verifies booking and payment status through job responses.
limitations: Requires a connected Tradehand MCP service; this package contains instructions, not a standalone booking application.
Private customer operations depend on client OAuth authentication and the tools available to that account.
Search results reflect current Tradehand directory coverage, not every local tradesperson or guaranteed availability.
Checkout links do not prove payment; final payment status depends on the job response.

use_cases.title: Compare Local Repair Options
use_cases.description: Find local plumbers or electricians and compare returned listings and service options before choosing a provider.

use_cases.title: Review a Maintenance Booking
use_cases.description: Prepare a fixed-price visit, review its address, time, and total, then approve the exact booking details.

use_cases.title: Request a Work Quote
use_cases.description: Use available quote tools for work without a fixed-price service and provide only missing job details.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Local Trade
prompt_templates.prompt: Find plumbers on Tradehand near [postcode] for [job]. Show actual listings and profile links. Do not prepare or commit a booking.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Service Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare returned Tradehand listings for [trade] near [postcode]. Inspect service options and report only returned details. Do not assume availability or book anything.

prompt_templates.title: Request a Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Request a Tradehand quote for [job] at [location] using available quote tools. Ask for missing details and preserve my wording. Do not commit a booking.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Approve a Booking
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare [service] with [listing reference] at [address and postcode]. Show live slots, address, and total. Wait for my exact approval before committing. Reconfirm changed reviews.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: authenticated booking with revision checks

output_examples.input: Find an electrician near my postcode, but do not book.
output: No current Tradehand listings were returned for your search.
This reflects directory coverage, not every electrician in the area.
No booking was prepared or committed.

output_examples.input: Prepare a visit, but my connection has no booking tools.
output: Customer booking tools are unavailable on this connection.
I can share the selected listing or contact handoff.

output_examples.input: The checkout link opened. Does that mean my job is paid?
output: Opening a checkout link does not confirm payment.
I need to check the job status before reporting payment.

best_practices: Use actual returned listings, identifiers, and current tool schemas; keep OAuth credentials in the client store.
Approve the exact live service, address, time, and total before booking; review again when slots or revisions change.
Verify booking and payment status through the job response after any checkout handoff.
anti_patterns: Inventing traders, credentials, reviews, prices, availability, or customer information.
Committing bookings without exact customer approval or reusing stale slots and price revisions.
Treating a search result as a booking or a checkout link as proof of payment.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support. The client must connect to Tradehand MCP and expose the needed tools.

faq.question: Do public searches require a customer account?
faq.answer: Public directory reads need no key. Private customer operations require the client's OAuth authentication flow.

faq.question: Can it book a visit without my approval?
faq.answer: The workflow requires your approval of the exact live service, address, time, and total before committing a booking.

faq.question: What happens when a booking review becomes stale?
faq.answer: The assistant prepares a new review and requests approval again if the server reports an unavailable slot or stale review.

faq.question: Can it request quotes for custom work?
faq.answer: It uses advertised quote tools for work without a fixed-price service. Available fields and steps depend on the current tool schemas.

faq.question: Does a checkout link mean the job is paid?
faq.answer: No. The assistant must check the job response before reporting paid status.
